_comment: Copy this file to mvconfig.json (gitignored) and edit. Any absent file/section/key falls back to the documented default; a malformed file warns to stderr and is ignored. JSON has no comments, so the _comment fields below document each key.
_comment_tokens: Web access is gated by ADMIN-MINTED, EXPIRING tokens (NOT a static secret here). Mint a token via `python main.py token create` or the web Access panel (from the local browser); tokens live in the gitignored mvtokens.json. The genuine-local (Alienware) browser is always admin and needs no token.

web._comment_host: Bind address for `python main.py web`. Default 127.0.0.1 (local only). Use 0.0.0.0 to reach the console from your LAN IP and your Tailscale IP. Binding 0.0.0.0 is SAFE by default: a remote peer needs a valid minted token; if none is minted, remote is simply locked out.
web._comment_port: Port for the web console. Default 8765.

tmdb._comment_api_key: Optional TMDB API key for metadata lookups. null/empty = unset.

omdb._comment_api_key: Optional OMDb (omdbapi.com) API key for the online-metadata refresh (IMP-E16): IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings + Rated/Runtime/Awards/BoxOffice. Populated by `python main.py refresh_online`, cached in the gitignored mvonline.json, and merged read-only into the hover dossier. null/empty = unset (refresh_online then no-ops).

rapidapi._comment: Reserved for future RapidAPI-backed IMDb / Rotten Tomatoes sources. Both null/empty = unset.

exa._comment_api_key: Optional EXA (exa.ai) API key for the trivia backfill (IMP-E16/A5): `python main.py fetch_trivia` web-searches each title's behind-the-scenes facts via EXA, GROQ distills them, and the result is cached in the gitignored mvextra.json and merged read-only into the hover dossier. null/empty = unset (fetch_trivia then no-ops).

groq._comment_api_key: Optional GROQ (groq.com) API key for the trivia backfill (IMP-E16/A5): GROQ's LLM distills the EXA web snippets into 2-4 short, source-tagged trivia facts. null/empty = unset (fetch_trivia then no-ops).
